hypotheses: Equal averaging of the two frozen full H/A/D vectors improves spell recovery if seed errors complement.
Long ball gaps and distance to reliable observed contact concentrate wrong-team errors on the current GRU.
Conditional on that diagnosis, 15s rather than 5s context each side improves recovery while keeping 10s output cores.
spec.probability_ensemble: 0.5 * (native H/A/D probability seed2026 + seed2027), then unchanged Viterbi cost3. No calibration.

calibration.calibration: Unlabeled tracking only; missingness does not identify true occlusion causes
calibration.coordinate_errors: Assumed ranges; no coordinate ground truth available

spec.aggregation: Replicates within match, matches within provider, equal provider mean. Do not pool frames for headline model ranking.
spec.holdout: Entire evaluation provider excluded from H/A, D and normalization; same five previously exposed external development matches.
spec.parity: All 10 clean individual-seed spell/macro/D-F1 rows and 20 feed-like rows must reproduce saved stress-component ablation to 1e-9; clean native probabilities to atol1e-6.

diagnostics.contacts: Existing geometry best-control >=.2, absolute H/A margin >=.2, stable .2s, native observed masks; no 10s age cap in diagnostic. Proxy, not ground truth.
diagnostics.gaps: Consecutive missing-ball intervals clipped at half/time breaks; frame strata apply inside gaps; no-gap separate. Duration includes whole interval, including unknown-label frames.
diagnostics.spells: Global official IoU.5 matches; midpoint strata plus maximum intersected gap; short <3s; fragmentation any positive same-team overlap with >=2 predictions. Graded-run edges reported.
diagnostics.turnovers: Direct adjacent H/A changes within graded runs. Greedy nearest same-direction one-to-one matches within 5s; report missed, within1s and signed/absolute timing; X/D breaks excluded.
diagnostics.distinction: On reference-live frames, wrong H/A, false D and X are disjoint; missed D reported separately.

spec.context_condition: Seed2026 feed-like: provider-balanced wrong-team rate > false-D rate among live gap>=10s; and wrong-team rate there exceeds live no-gap rate. This is a descriptive development trigger, not a significance test.

context_experiment.fixed: Features, labels, normalization population, augmentation whole-window choices, source/match weights, parameters, window count, update count, decoder3. Only context span changes.
context_experiment.falsifier: No positive matched spell delta and long-gap team-accuracy delta in both seeds; guardrail failure prevents recommending follow-up.
context_experiment.guardrails: Each seed clean spell >= own 5s-control -.01; feed-like spell >= own control -.01; each provider clean D-F1 and macro >= own control -.02.
context_experiment.budget: Six new fits, no early stopping, eight epochs, 30 new match/view/seed cells. Seal all six before scoring. No extra contexts or seed selection.
